narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>School is seven hours, so the school is seven boxes.
<bookmark mark='lay'/>Seven hours is right, but look at how many boxes seven hours covers on the strip.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each hour needs two boxes, not one.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 7 hours = 7 boxes; seven hours of the strip are laid out and fill more than seven boxes; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Multiply the hours by two to get the boxes. Count the boxes before it starts, then add one for its first box.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Tuition runs from four o'clock to six thirty in the evening. How many boxes, and where does it start?
